hints.content: There are many ways to find the vertex. We will do it by using the fact that the $x$-coordinate of the vertex is exactly between the two zeros.

In conclusion,

$\begin{align}
\text{smaller }x&=-9
\\\\
\text{larger }x&=-8
\end{align}$

The vertex of the parabola is at

$\left(-\dfrac{17}{2},-\dfrac{1}{4}\right)$

question.content:
$g(x)=(x+9)(x+8)$

**1) What are the zeros of the function?**
